Fixed `last_n.rb`: the body is now `items.last(n)`, which removes the off-by-one. I didn't run it.

I used `last` rather than just dropping the `- 1`, because the slice version still misbehaves when `n` is larger than the array (the negative start index returns `nil` or the wrong slice). `items.last(n)` returns the whole array in that case.
